stories.title: Two drug drivers among five people arrested in South Flintshire in 24 hours
stories.summary: Police in South Flintshire made five arrests in 24 hours, including two drug drivers. North Wales Police’s South Flintshire team said it received 44 calls for service in that time. stories.title: School leaders across Wales vote for strike action in pay and funding dispute
stories.summary: School leaders across Wales have voted for industrial action, including strike action, in a dispute over pay, funding and workload. stories.title: Five new crossings planned on A548 between Greenfield and Walwen
stories.summary: Five new crossings are planned on and around the A548 Bagillt Road between Greenfield and Walwen. Flintshire County Council published legal notices for the crossings on Friday 27 November. They are a zebra crossing, a toucan crossing, two parallel crossings and a signalised pedestrian crossing. stories.title: Walk-in flu jab clinics open across north Wales from 1 December
stories.summary: Eligible adults and pre-school children in north Wales can walk in to a community clinic for their NHS flu vaccine without an appointment from Tuesday 1 December, Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board has said. stories.title: Gary Speed: 15 years since death of Deeside-born Wales manager
stories.summary: It is 15 years today since Mancot-born Gary Speed died while he was manager of Wales. He died on 27 November 2011, aged 42.
